title: Demo: Battlecard vs a main competitor for finance buyers
brief:
Audience: finance leaders at mid-size companies who are comparing us with a main competitor.
Output: a one-page battlecard my sales team can use on calls.
Decision: when to lead with time-to-value and when to lead with integrations.

plan.rationale: Default battlecard plan, shortened: the product file already holds approved positioning, so I skipped the positioning task and went straight from research to the battlecard.
